svg.title: Private and local-first: your keys, your machine, your data. OmniRoute adds no OmniRoute-hosted prompt-processing hop; telemetry is disabled by default. Request routing runs on your hardware via npm, Docker, desktop or phone. Credentials encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. No OmniRoute-hosted account service — the operator controls dashboard identity with a local password or optional OIDC. Hardened gateway with API-key scoping, IP filtering, rate limits and prompt-injection guard. Process-spawning routes are loopback-only so a leaked token cannot spawn processes. Upstream header scrubbing strips deny-listed headers before every provider call. PII redaction and response sanitization are available and run only when enabled. Sanitized errors redact credentials, stack traces and recognized filesystem paths. A local audit trail logs MCP tool calls and admin actions in your own SQLite. MIT licensed and fully open-source — audit every line, self-host forever.
svg.desc: Animated privacy ledger: eleven fully readable rows on the first frame; a soft green highlight sweeps down the rows in a continuous cycle.
svg.text: Your keys, your machine, your data. No
Request routing runs on your hardware — npm, Docker, desktop, or your phone
Telemetry disabled by default — activates only when explicitly configured
Credentials encrypted at rest — API keys & OAuth tokens sealed on your own disk
No OmniRoute-hosted account service — operator controls dashboard identity: local password or optional OIDC
Hardened gateway — API-key scoping, IP filtering, rate limits, prompt-injection guard
Process routes are loopback-only — a token leaked through a tunnel can’t spawn processes
Upstream header scrubbing — deny-listed headers stripped before every provider call
PII redaction & response sanitization — built in, strictly opt-in — These redactions run only when enabled
Sanitized errors — redact credentials, stack traces & recognized file paths
Local audit trail — MCP tool calls & admin actions logged in your SQLite, not ours
MIT licensed & fully open-source — audit every line, self-host forever
